text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Do you remember the promise we 
made when we went out before?
choice_data_list:
Right. That thing where you visit 
someone's recommended spot.

Yeah. The one where we visit someone's 
recommended spot, right?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, how about today as well? 
Let us go forge our bonds once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after walking for a while...

text_block_list.name: Storytelling Guy
text_block_list.text:
"Dear guests, please fix your hair here, 
and make sure to clean the mud off your 
footwear."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: That's...
choice_data_list: A read-aloud, huh. Is it for volunteering?
A read-aloud, huh. Is it for volunteering?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It appears so. Over there, there's even a 
sign that says 'Open-Air Storytelling 
Class'...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ! "Seeking Volunteer Story Readers"...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"‘Now, let's head out on an adventure! 
Heigh-ho!’ And then, the glutton Jiro 
chimed in: ‘Let's eat first! Heigh-ho!’"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Kyahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite participating as a walk-in, 
Victoire Pisa was immediately accepted by 
the children.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, wanna go to the horizontal bars? Or 
play tag! —Ehh, but we're still in the 
middle of talking...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps tired of standing still, voices 
like that began popping up here and there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa seems to have noticed as 
well, but since some students are 
listening attentively, she seems unsure of 
what to do.

text_block_list.name: Mischievous-Looking Boy
text_block_list.text:
Let's all just 'quit' together! That'll 
solve everything!
choice_data_list: (I wonder if that girl is the leader)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, if she can enjoy the 
reading, the children around her will 
naturally follow suit. —In which case...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"The phantom kidnapper chuckled at Hanako. 
Then, with a dramatic sweep of his cape—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following the story, I dramatically sweep 
my cape, recite the Phantom's lines with 
flair, and step in front of the little 
girl standing next to that boy.

text_block_list.name: Lively Girl
text_block_list.text: Huh! Wh-Who is this person?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Ignoring the buzzing children, I cast a 
quick glance over at Victoire Pisa."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
! "Kenji gathered all his courage and 
stepped in front of Hanako. Then he 
shouted, 'I won't let you!'"
choice_data_list:
"Are you sure? I might just take you away 
with me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no actual line like that, but... 
putting on an act, I glanced over at that 
boy.

text_block_list.name: Mischievous-Looking Boy
text_block_list.text: ! I-I won't let you! Get lost, monster!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Behind Kenji, Hanako said, 'Everyone, 
let's use our special moves! If we combine 
our strength, we can definitely do it!'"

text_block_list.name: Lively Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... Y-yeah, exactly! "You can 
totally do it"!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Kenji nodded at Hanako's words. 'Raise 
your hands, everyone! Say the spell 
together! Ready, and—'"

text_block_list.name: Mischievous-Looking Boy
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, put your hands up! Let's cast 
the spell together! Ready, set—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "Run, ran, ren, ren! Shoo, shoo, go away!"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: "Run, ran, ren, ren! Shoo, shoo, go away!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to our ingenuity paying off, the 
picture-book reading ended in great 
success—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, the boy who seemed to be 
the ringleader took my hand and led me to 
a nearby shopping street.

text_block_list.name: Mischievous-Looking Boy
text_block_list.text:
"Mom, I'm home! Hey, hey! Make some 
taiyaki for these folks!"

text_block_list.name: Mischievous-Looking Boy
text_block_list.text:
The storytime these big sis's did was 
super fun! Books are so awesome!

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well! For someone who spends all 
her time running around outside to show an 
interest in books!"

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, guys. All right, taiyaki is on 
me!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um, please don't worry about it. Just 
knowing you care is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
We can't have that! It's our lucky 
meeting, so please, eat up!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
We certainly received quite a lot, didn't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Fufufu! To think it would turn out 
like this...♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that was a wonderful time, wasn't 
it? The smiles just kept spreading 
around...”
choice_data_list:
It's all thanks to the bonds you traced, 
Pisa.

It's all thanks to the bonds you traced, 
Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
......No. It was not through my strength 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I was thinking of taking a 
break. The children have their limits when 
it comes to concentration, after all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However, thanks to you, Trainer, everyone 
was able to enjoy themselves right up to 
the very end.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...So there are ways like that to connect 
people, too.
choice_data_list:
It's thanks to you catching on so quickly, 
Pisa.

Well, you've got a great master right in 
front of you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...To be honest, my heart skipped a beat.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—I was wondering what I'd do if I was 
wrong.
choice_data_list: I knew I could count on you, Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much. ...It is all 
thanks to the time we spend together every 
day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ? Could you mean... me?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly humbled. To think of being 
Trainer's master, of all things.
choice_data_list:
I will continue to watch and learn from 
you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! ...Then Master must devote herself 
to training even harder.
